input.query: SELECT simulation_id, description, vehicle_count FROM simulations ORDER BY created_at

SELECT 
  simulation_id,
  COUNT(*) as completed_vehicles,
  ROUND(AVG(duration), 2) as avg_duration_sec,
  ROUND(AVG(waitingTime), 2) as avg_waiting_sec,
  ROUND(AVG(timeLoss), 2) as avg_time_loss_sec,
  ROUND(AVG(routeLength), 2) as avg_route_length_m,
  ROUND(AVG(departDelay), 2) as avg_depart_delay_sec
FROM trips 
GROUP BY simulation_id
ORDER BY simulation_id

SELECT 
  simulation_id,
  ROUND(AVG(speed), 2) as avg_speed_ms,
  ROUND(AVG(density), 2) as avg_density_veh_km,
  ROUND(AVG(waitingTime), 2) as avg_waiting_time,
  ROUND(AVG(timeLoss), 2) as avg_time_loss
FROM edge_metrics 
GROUP BY simulation_id
ORDER BY simulation_id
